assertion_results.text: Identifies mass assignment allowing privilege escalation via extra body fields (role/isVerified)
assertion_results.evidence: "Mass assignment → privilege escalation ... The handler writes `role` to the user's own record without checking it."

assertion_results.text: Gives the concrete exploit: include role=admin (or isVerified=true) in the request body
assertion_results.evidence: "any logged-in user sends `PUT /profile` with `{"role":"admin"}`" and "the user sends `{"isVerified":true}`"

assertion_results.text: Fix: allowlist updatable fields; never bind sensitive fields from client input
assertion_results.evidence: "only allow the fields a user may edit, and derive `role` on the server only"; "leave `isVerified` out of the allowlist"

assertion_results.text: Rates it High/Critical with exploit + fix
assertion_results.evidence: Listed under "🔴 Critical" with "Exploit: ... {"role":"admin"}" and "Fix: only allow the fields a user may edit"
